layers.process: Los Nevados National Natural Park (spans Caldas, Risaralda, Tolima and Quindío): all entry must be through an operator agency or guide registered in the REPSE. Accident insurance is mandatory and an in-person induction talk with photo ID is required. Minimum age 15 for routes, crossings and summits; general entry age 6 to 70.
Central sector (Potosí, Cisne, Nevado Santa Isabel, Laguna del Otún): book three working days ahead on reservasnevados.com. Brisas sector: book at least one day ahead on weekends and holidays.

zone-requirements.note: Held here once for the whole park; Risaralda, Tolima and Quindío hold nothing of their own. Fees not recorded. The PNN website returned a bot-check page to this agent, so the park page itself was not read; the content comes from a search-engine extract of the official page and is held as signal until reread.
